limitations: Single-variant fetch: one geography, one device profile, no logged-in state, no cookie consent accepted. Personalization and geo/consent-gated content are not observed.
Lab proxy, not field data: latency and Core Web Vitals appear as risk factors measured once, not real-user metrics.
Network-dependent checks (sameAs resolvability, broken links) reflect what was reachable at audit time and are excluded from the byte-for-byte determinism guarantee.

findings.title: No Organization entity anchor in JSON-LD
findings.evidence: No Organization/LocalBusiness/Corporation JSON-LD node on any sampled page (0/1 pages). Engines have no machine-readable brand node to anchor to.
findings.mechanism: AI engines resolve the brand string to a knowledge-graph node BEFORE evaluating page content; with no stable anchor, entity consolidation and knowledge-panel eligibility never begin.

suggested_action.summary: Add one Organization JSON-LD node with a stable @id, plus name, url and logo, on the homepage (and reference it site-wide).
suggested_action.mechanism: AI engines resolve the brand string to a knowledge-graph node BEFORE evaluating page content; with no stable anchor, entity consolidation and knowledge-panel eligibility never begin.

findings.title: Missing rel=canonical
findings.evidence: 1/1 pages have no rel=canonical link (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:38479/index.html).
findings.mechanism: Without a canonical, engines may index a duplicate URL and attribute the fact to the wrong page, splitting authority.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential absolute rel=canonical to each key page.
suggested_action.mechanism: Without a canonical, engines may index a duplicate URL and attribute the fact to the wrong page, splitting authority.

findings.title: No off-site identity surface found
findings.evidence: No sameAs, no footer/social profile links, and no Wikipedia/Wikidata link on any of the 1 sampled pages.
findings.mechanism: The large majority of AI brand mentions are sourced from third-party pages; with zero off-site surface there is structurally little for an engine to cite.

suggested_action.summary: Establish and link off-site identity surfaces (social profiles, Crunchbase, Wikidata/Wikipedia) and mirror them in Organization.sameAs.
suggested_action.mechanism: The large majority of AI brand mentions are sourced from third-party pages; with zero off-site surface there is structurally little for an engine to cite.

findings.title: Page has no <h1>
findings.mechanism: The h1 anchors the page's main topic for machine outlining; without it the content hierarchy is ambiguous.

suggested_action.summary: Add exactly one <h1> stating the page's primary subject.
suggested_action.mechanism: The h1 anchors the page's main topic for machine outlining; without it the content hierarchy is ambiguous.

findings.title: Missing landmarks, skip link, or a clear above-fold value proposition
findings.evidence: no <main>/role=main on 1/1 pages; no skip-to-content link on 1/1 pages; no clear above-fold value prop (H1 + descriptive paragraph) on 1/1 pages. Heuristic; value-prop baked into a hero image is not detected.
findings.mechanism: Landmarks and skip links aid keyboard/screen-reader navigation; a clear above-fold value prop tells arrivals they're in the right place, reducing bounce.

suggested_action.summary: Wrap primary content in <main>, add a skip-to-content link, and lead with an H1 plus a one-line description of what the page offers.
suggested_action.mechanism: Landmarks and skip links aid keyboard/screen-reader navigation; a clear above-fold value prop tells arrivals they're in the right place, reducing bounce.

findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.evidence: 1/1 pages have no meta description (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:38479/index.html).
findings.mechanism: A meta description gives extractors a ready-made summary snippet; its absence is a minor, recoverable gap.

suggested_action.summary: Add a concise meta description summarizing the page (soft advisory).
suggested_action.mechanism: A meta description gives extractors a ready-made summary snippet; its absence is a minor, recoverable gap.
